definitionZh: 文本-装饰-厚度 CSS 属性设置在一个元素中用于文本的装饰线的中风厚度,例如线通过,下划线,或上线.
sourceDefinition: The text-decoration-thickness CSS property sets the stroke thickness of the decoration line that is used on text in an element, such as a line-through, underline, or overline.
